text: I feel a sense of curiosity in this space, as if I am standing on the threshold of discovery. The glass walls separate me from a room dedicated to research and development—a place where ideas are born and tested. The vibrant colors and bold letters invite me in, promising innovation. There is an energy here that nudges me to ponder humanity's relentless pursuit of knowledge, and I feel invigorated by the possibility of witnessing or even participating in something transformative.
